dfa2dddc: What is the name of Shoyo Hinata's high school?
Hinata joins Karasuno High, in Miyagi Prefecture, the former school of his idol, the Little Giant.
66217bb6: Which animal is the symbol of the Karasuno team?
Karasuno means “field of crows”, and the team is nicknamed the Crows.
4a183f78: What position does Tobio Kageyama play?
Kageyama is a setter. His precision lets him send the ball exactly where Hinata will hit it.
607fbf2f: What nickname did Kageyama's former teammates give him in middle school?
At Kitagawa Daiichi middle school, his teammates called him “the King of the Court” because of his tyrannical play: they ended up refusing to follow his sets.
06fc926e: Why did Hinata take up volleyball?
He saw the Little Giant play on TV
As a child, Hinata saw Karasuno's Little Giant on TV, a short spiker who soared over the blockers.
b4ee3f87: What number does Hinata wear at Karasuno?
Hinata wears number 10, the number the Little Giant wore when he played for Karasuno.
f9f4650b: Despite his small size, Hinata plays middle blocker: his jump and his speed make up for his lack of height.
4a943977: Who is Karasuno's captain at the start of the series?
Daichi Sawamura, number 1, is Karasuno's captain and the backbone of its receive.
4ab74d3e: Who is Karasuno's ace, who stopped coming to practice for a while?
Asahi Azumane lost his confidence after being blocked again and again by Date Tech. He comes back thanks to his teammates.
9abdb489: Which Karasuno player is the libero?
Yu Nishinoya, small but spectacular, is Karasuno's libero.
21f51228: Nishinoya is called “Karasuno's Guardian Deity” for his impossible digs.
33395352: What is special about Kei Tsukishima?
He is tall, wears glasses and plays middle blocker with cold intelligence
He is the shortest on the team
Tsukishima is a tall, calculating middle blocker, often sarcastic, whose blocking becomes decisive against Shiratorizawa.
76fdc6b6: Which lie told by Tsukishima's older brother left a mark on him?
He said he had quit volleyball
He said he had been picked for the national team
He said he was a starter at Karasuno
Akiteru Tsukishima claimed to be a starter at Karasuno when he was actually a substitute. Kei found out when he came to watch him play.
b2e9f39e: What is Tadashi Yamaguchi's role in important matches?
Yamaguchi comes on to serve. He learned the jump float serve from Makoto Shimada, a former player.
67481522: Keishin Ukai, grandson of the famous coach Ukai, agrees to coach the team. He runs his family's shop near the school.
d3faf717: The club's faculty adviser, who knows nothing about volleyball
Takeda, a teacher at the school, is the club's adviser. He knows nothing about volleyball, but works hard to arrange practice matches.
0dfccc77: Kiyoko Shimizu, a third-year, recruits Hitoka Yachi, a first-year who will succeed her.
05520d5c: Which third-year setter gives up his starting spot to Kageyama?
Koshi Sugawara, number 2, remains a valuable substitute, able to change the rhythm of a match.
45c13593: What is the name of Ryunosuke Tanaka's sister, who plays taiko in the stands?
Saeko Tanaka plays the Japanese drum with a group of supporters at Karasuno's big matches.
66572284: Kazuyo, Kageyama's grandfather, coached children and passed his love of volleyball on to him.
c3444146: In which challenge do Hinata and Kageyama have to face each other and then team up as soon as they join the club?
After a fight, they have to win a three-on-three match against Tsukishima and Yamaguchi to be accepted into the club.
39b76331: How does the first version of Hinata and Kageyama's quick attack work?
Hinata jumps with his eyes closed and Kageyama sends the ball into his hand
Hinata jumps with all his strength without looking at the ball: it is Kageyama who places it in his hand, to the millimeter.
4a42ed3d: Which high school does Toru Oikawa play for?
Oikawa, setter and captain, leads Aoba Johsai. He was Kageyama's senior in middle school.
55b1e088: Who is Oikawa's childhood friend and teammate?
Hajime Iwaizumi, Aoba Johsai's ace, has known Oikawa since childhood and is one of the few who can put him in his place.
b9f77bcc: Which Tokyo high school is Karasuno's great historic rival?
Karasuno and Nekoma, the crows and the cats, have been rivals since the days when their former coaches faced each other.
67205d20: What position does Kenma Kozume play?
Kenma, who loves video games, is Nekoma's setter and its “brain”.
101e20f8: Tetsuro Kuroo is Nekoma's captain and middle blocker, and Kenma's childhood friend.
ed008fb1: What does the Nekoma team compare itself to in its pre-match chant?
The blood flowing through the veins
The Nekoma players compare themselves to circulating blood, and their setter Kenma to the brain that keeps everything running.
826ce0fe: Wakatoshi Ushijima, a left-handed spiker of extraordinary power, is one of the best players in the country.
1ff2c5a1: What is the nickname of Satori Tendo of Shiratorizawa?
Tendo blocks by guessing attacks rather than reading them: he is called “the Guess Monster”.
0c999b18: What is the Date Tech team famous for?
Its block, nicknamed the Iron Wall
Date Tech is known for its block, the Iron Wall, whose cornerstone is the middle blocker Takanobu Aone.
1a863397: Kotaro Bokuto, a spiker famous for his mood swings, leads Fukurodani with his setter Keiji Akaashi.
222749c1: Atsumu, the setter, and Osamu Miya are Inarizaki's star duo, whom Karasuno faces at Nationals.
77cbe95f: Which Kamomedai player reminds people of Hinata because of his small size?
Korai Hoshiumi, a short spiker with an exceptional jump, is often presented as the successor to the Little Giant.
17a79f0d: Who coached Nekoma during the great rivalry with the old coach Ukai?
Yasufumi Nekomata, still Nekoma's coach, dreamed of playing Karasuno again on the national stage.
fa4a89ae: Against which team did Hinata play his very first official match in middle school?
Hinata's Yukigaoka middle school team, cobbled together from whoever was available, lost in the first round to Kitagawa Daiichi, where Kageyama played.
7cab940a: What is a match between Karasuno and Nekoma called?
The Battle at the Garbage Dump
Crows and cats fight over garbage: their match is nicknamed the Battle at the Garbage Dump.
8d7c4483: Which team does Karasuno beat in the prefectural final to reach Nationals?
Karasuno beats Ushijima's Shiratorizawa in five sets, a match that takes up the whole third season of the anime.
23a9eb8c: Why does Hinata have to leave the court against Kamomedai at Nationals?
He passes out after a collision
Hinata, running a fever, is taken off by his coach. Karasuno loses this quarterfinal, and Hinata learns a lesson about preparation.
34171757: Which team does Karasuno lose to at the Inter-High tournament, before its big comeback in the spring?
Karasuno falls to Oikawa's Aoba Johsai, a defeat that pushes Hinata and Kageyama to rethink their attack.
cfb08ec4: In which match does Tsukishima make his decisive block on Ushijima?
The first match against Aoba Johsai
Tsukishima's block on Ushijima, in the prefectural final, is one of the most famous moments of the series.
5420a266: How many players does each team have on the court?
A volleyball team has six players on the court.
902c77cf: How many touches can a team make before sending the ball back?
Three touches at most, usually receive, set and attack. A touch on the block does not count.
2da7c5de: How many points is a set played to, apart from the deciding set?
A set is won at 25 points with a two-point lead; the deciding set is played to 15 points.
14963453: Why does the libero wear a different-colored jersey?
He is a defensive player with special rules
The libero, a defensive specialist, comes on and off freely but cannot attack above the net: the jersey makes him easy to spot.
0b52f10a: What is the main role of the setter?
Distributing the ball to the hitters
The setter runs the attack by choosing who will hit and how, like Kageyama, Oikawa or Kenma.
697a48ac: A serve with no spin and an unpredictable path
A very powerful serve with spin
Hit without spin, the ball floats and changes direction at the last moment: it is Yamaguchi's weapon.
3ac2cd59: What sport does Hinata play in Brazil after high school?
Hinata spends two years in Rio playing beach volleyball to become a complete player. He runs into Oikawa there.
91b68cac: Which Japanese professional team does Hinata play for with Bokuto and Atsumu?
Hinata joins the MSBY Black Jackals and faces Kageyama, who plays for the Schweiden Adlers.
8e7aabe8: Which national team does Oikawa play for as an adult?
After moving to Argentina, Oikawa becomes a citizen and plays for the Argentine national team.
b4d4425f: What career does Kenma choose after high school?
YouTuber, professional gamer and business owner
Kenma becomes a successful YouTuber and founds his own company. He even backs Hinata as a sponsor.
58aacffe: What job does Daichi Sawamura have as an adult?
Karasuno's former captain becomes a police officer.
47142bf9: Who is the author of Haikyu!!?
Haruichi Furudate published Haikyu!! in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2012 to 2020.
939f8e70: How many volumes does the manga have?
62ad08d7: Which studio made the anime adaptation?
Production I.G has adapted Haikyu!! since 2014, up to the film about the Battle at the Garbage Dump released in 2024.
1d5cf8a3: Which band performs “Imagination”, the anime's first opening theme?
SPYAIR's “Imagination” opens the first season of the anime in 2014.
